answer: The scarce resource here is independent judgment. Every identity must explain one real mechanism on a seeded falcon, and peers read the reasoning. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the whisper of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the summit behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal 1n78d.
